translation: 几个世纪以来，亚特兰蒂斯一直是西方世界最受欢迎的传说之一，是幻想与神秘的诱人结合。故事讲述了一个富裕而辉煌的帝国消失在大海中的故事，一些人希望它的废墟仍然存在，等待被发现。

title: Non-Material Culture
text: For the purposes of argument, culture is divided into material and non-material, and the speaker's aim is to show how they both affect each other. Material developments in tools and technology can affect non-material culture, our customs and beliefs, and the other way around. Genetics is used as an example as it has changed the way we think about life, but also our beliefs have affected its rate of development.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 为了论证的目的，文化被分为物质文化和非物质文化，演讲者的目的是展示它们如何相互影响。工具和技术的物质发展可以影响非物质文化、我们的习俗和信仰，反之亦然。以遗传学为例，因为它改变了我们思考生命的方式，但我们的信仰也影响了它的发展速度。

title: Trade Unions
text: Trade unions originated in Europe during the Industrial Revolution. Because of the machinery that had become commonplace, skilled labour became less in demand so employers had nearly all of the bargaining power. Employers mistreated the workers and paid them too little for the work they did. Trade unions were organised that would help in the improvement of working conditions.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 工会起源于工业革命时期的欧洲。由于机械化的普遍应用，熟练工人的需求下降，使得雇主几乎垄断了所有的议价权。雇主苛待工人并压低工资。工会的建立旨在改善工作环境和劳动保障。

title: Reading
text: The student's reading in his own subject slows down, and his comprehension becomes less secure. He expresses himself slowly and often fails to convey his ideas exactly. He is disappointed to find that under pressure he makes a lot of unnecessary mistakes in areas where he knows the correct language forms. His social relations are difficult as he cannot find the right phrase quickly enough to keep a conversation going, so his language often betrays him into dullness, coldness, or worst of all, rudeness. Instead of the students being in control of the language, the language seems now to be in control of the students.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 学生在自己的学科中的阅读速度变慢，他的理解力也变得不那么可靠。他表达缓慢，常常无法准确表达自己的想法。他失望地发现，在压力下，他在他知道正确语言形式的领域犯了很多不必要的错误。他的社交关系很困难，因为他无法足够快地找到合适的短语来维持对话，因此他的语言常常让他变得迟钝、冷漠，或者最糟糕的是，粗鲁。现在，语言似乎不再由学生控制语言，而是由学生控制。

title: Fast Radio Burst
text: First discovered in 2007, "fast radio burst" continue to defy explanation. These cosmic chirps last a thousandth of a second. The characteristics of the radio pulses suggested that they came from galaxies billions of light-years away. However, new works points to a much closer origin-flaring star within our own galaxy.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 2007 年首次发现的“快速射电暴”仍然无法解释。这些宇宙鸣叫持续千分之一秒。射电脉冲的特征表明它们来自数十亿光年外的星系。然而，新的研究指出我们银河系中有一颗距离更近的起源耀斑恒星。

title: Industrial Revolution
text: As to the Industrial Revolution, one cannot dispute today the fact that it has succeeded in inaugurating in a number of countries, a level of mass prosperity which was undreamt of in the days preceding the Industrial Revolution. But, on the immediate impact of Industrial Revolution, there were substantial divergences among writers.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 至于工业革命，今天无可争议的事实是，它已经在许多国家成功地开创了工业革命之前无法想象的大众繁荣水平。但是，对于工业革命的直接影响，作家之间存在着巨大的分歧。

title: Russia
text: Long isolated from Western Europe, Russia grew up without participating in the development like the Reformation where many Europeans, taking pride in their unique culture, find dubious value. Russia is, as a result, the most unusual member of European family, if indeed it is European at all. The question is still open to debate, particularly among Russians themselves.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 俄罗斯长期与西欧隔绝，在成长过程中没有参与宗教改革这样的发展，许多欧洲人对其独特的文化感到自豪，但发现其价值可疑。因此，俄罗斯是欧洲大家庭中最不寻常的成员，如果它确实是欧洲的话。这个问题仍然有争议，特别是在俄罗斯人自己之间。

title: Public Demand for Education
text: Public demand for education has remained strong, reflecting the importance of education as a means of social progress. Aware of the added value of education to the world of work, the government continues to innovate and update the education system in order to produce a qualified and competent workforce.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 公众对教育的需求依然强劲，反映出教育作为社会进步手段的重要性。政府意识到教育对职场的附加价值，因此不断创新和更新教育体系，以培养合格、有能力的劳动力。

title: The Royal Institution
text: The Royal Institution is an organization that has been around for 209 years. Many of the people that have worked here have been scientists themselves, including Michael Faraday. He made the discoveries that made generating and using electricity much easier, making it possible for us all to switch on lights, cook our dinner, play games consoles much, much more.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 英国皇家学会是一个已有 209 年历史的组织。许多在这里工作的人本身就是科学家，包括迈克尔·法拉第。他的发现使发电和用电变得更加容易，使我们所有人都可以开灯、做饭、玩游戏机。

title: Fast Food
text: Hundreds of millions of people eat fast food every day without giving it much thought. They just unwrap their hamburgers and dig in. An hour or so later, when the burger's all gone and the wrapper's been tossed into the bin, the whole meal has already been forgotten.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 数以亿计的人每天都在不加思考地吃快餐。他们只是打开汉堡包然后大口吃起来。大约一个小时后，当汉堡包全部吃完并且包装纸被扔进垃圾箱时，整顿饭都已经被遗忘了。

title: Restaurant Location
text: The physical location of a restaurant in the competitive landscape of the city has long been known as a major factor in its likely success or failure. Once restaurants are established in such environments they can do little about their location. All they can do is work to improve customer access to their premises. Restaurateurs often do this by engaging in battles with local authorities about car parking.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 长期以来，餐厅在城市竞争格局中的物理位置一直被认为是其成功或失败的主要因素。一旦餐馆在这样的环境中开业，他们就无法对其选址做任何改变。他们所能做的就是努力改善客户对其场所的访问。餐馆老板经常通过与地方当局就停车问题进行斗争来做到这一点。

title: Windows in the Painting
text: We can see from the X-rays that at an early stage of painting, a window was painted in at the left of the portrait. It seems that there may have been two windows in the initial design for the portrait or that the window was moved at an early stage.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速

translation: 从X光片上我们可以看到，在绘画的早期阶段，肖像的左侧画了一个窗户。看来在最初的肖像设计中可能有两个窗户，或者窗户是在早期被移动的。

title: The Training of an Actor
text: The training of an actor is an intensive process which requires curiosity, courage and commitment. You will learn how to prepare for rehearsal, how to rehearse and how to use independent and proactive processes that inform you to do the best work possible for both stage and screen.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 演员的训练是一个密集的过程，需要好奇心、勇气和奉献精神。您将学习如何为排练做准备、如何排练以及如何使用独立和主动的流程来指导您在舞台和银幕上尽可能做到最好的工作。

title: Tourism
text: Tourism is a challenging sector that divides statistics since businesses serve tourists, also serve local people. Therefore, it is not straightforward to estimate how much business sectors’ revenues and how many jobs are due to tourist expenditures.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 旅游业是一个具有挑战性的行业，由于企业既为游客服务，也为当地人服务，因此统计数据也存在分歧。因此，无法直接估计有多少商业部门的收入和多少工作岗位是由旅游支出产生的。

title: Telecommunication
text: Today, telecommunication is widespread and devices that assist the progress are common in many parts of the world. There is also a vast array of networks that connect these devices, including computer, telephone and cable networks. Computer communication across the Internet, such as e-mail and instant messaging, is just one of many examples of telecommunication.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 如今，电信已普及，有助于进步的设备在世界许多地方也很常见。还有大量网络连接这些设备，包括计算机、电话和有线网络。通过互联网进行的计算机通信，例如电子邮件和即时消息传递，只是电信的众多示例之一。

title: Flood Control
text: We’ve spent a lot of money over the last 70 years on flood control, and it’s protected millions of people and has saved us billions of dollars. We’ve built dams to hold back the waters. We’ve built levees to keep the water off the people, and we’ve raised the ones that were originally started in 1718.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 过去70年来，我们在防洪设施上投入了巨额资金，保护了数以百万计的居民，并挽救了数百亿美元的损失。我们修建了大坝蓄水，构筑了堤坝隔离洪水，并加固抬高了最早始建于1718年的老堤坝。

title: The Best Time to Visit Canada
text: The best time to visit Canada is during fall months, when mild temperatures and vibrant fall foliage make scenic drives, hiking, and outdoor exploration especially enjoyable. Travel guides often highlight autumn – especially from late September through October – as a peak season for color changes in Ontario, Quebec, and other regions of the country.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 游览加拿大的最佳时间是秋季，此时温和的气温和生机勃勃的秋叶使风景优美的驾车、徒步旅行和户外探险变得特别愉快。旅游指南经常强调秋季——尤其是从九月下旬到十月——是安大略省、魁北克省和该国其他地区色彩变化的旺季。

title: The Source of Funding
text: A study found that the research funded by the soft drinks industry had different results from research funded by other sources and went on to suggest that they may have been biased by the research itself. The whole point of the scientific methods is to ensure the research results are not influenced by the source of funding.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 一项研究发现，由软饮料行业资助的研究与其他来源资助的研究得出了不同的结果，并继续表明他们可能因研究本身而存在偏见。科学方法的重点是确保研究结果不受资金来源的影响。

title: Recycle
text: When we recycle, used materials are converted into new products, reducing the need to consume natural resources. If used materials are not recycled, new products are made by extracting fresh, raw material from the Earth, through mining and forestry. Recycling helps conserve important raw materials and protects natural habitats for the future.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 当我们回收时，用过的材料被转化为新产品，减少了对自然资源的消耗。如果使用过的材料不被回收，则可以通过采矿和林业从地球上提取新鲜的原材料来制造新产品。回收有助于节省重要的原材料并保护未来的自然栖息地。

title: A World Without Light
text: Have you ever pictured a world without light? Just think how much we rely on man-made light sources in our lives. Without engineers, we wouldn't be able to live the way we do. No streetlights, no TV, no computer displays, no house lights. Engineers design and build all these things.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 你想象过一个没有光的世界吗？想想我们在生活中对人造光源的依赖程度。没有工程师，我们将无法像现在这样生活。没有路灯，没有电视，没有电脑显示器，没有房子的灯。工程师设计和建造所有这些东西。

title: Companies
text: Companies will want to be known not just for the financial results they generate, but equally for the imprint they leave on society as a whole. First, ensuring that their products contribute positively. Second, operating in a way that approaches a net-neutral impact to the natural environment. And third, cherishing their people.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 企业不仅希望因其创造的财务成果而闻名，同样也希望因其对整个社会的深远影响而被铭记。第一，确保其产品带来积极贡献；第二，以接近对自然环境零负面影响的方式运营；第三，珍视关爱他们的员工。

title: Blue
text: While blue is one of the most popular colors, it is one of the least appetizing. Food researchers say that when humans searched for food, they learned to avoid toxic or spoiled objects, which were often blue, black or purple. When food dyed blue is served to study subjects, they lose appetite.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 蓝色虽是最受欢迎的颜色之一，却是最让人没有食欲的颜色之一。食品研究人员表示，人类在进化中学会避开有毒或变质的物体，而这些物体往往呈蓝色、黑色或紫色。当向研究对象提供染成蓝色的食物时，他们就会食欲大减。

title: Father
text: Every morning, no matter how late he had been up, my father rose at five-thirty, went to his study, wrote for a couple of hours, made us all breakfast, read the paper with my mother, and then went back to work for the rest of the morning. Many years passed before I realized that he did this for a living.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 全球变暖是指地球气候系统平均气温的长期上升。它是气候变化的主要表征，已通过直接的气温测量以及变暖带来的多重效应得到了证实。自工业革命以来的人类活动，尤其是化石燃料的燃烧，是导致这一现象的最主要诱因。

title: Shakespeare
text: A young man from a small provincial town - a man without independent wealth, without powerful family connections and without a university education - moves to London in the late 1580s and, in a remarkably short time, becomes the greatest playwright not of his age alone but of all time. How is an achievement of magnitude made? How did Shakespeare become Shakespeare?

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 大象是地球上现存最大的陆生哺乳动物。它们以非凡的智力、复杂的社会结构和深厚的情感纽带而闻名。大象通过多种声音进行交流，包括可以通过地面传播数公里的低频隆隆声，使象群能够跨越辽阔的距离保持联系。

title: Yellow
text: While yellow is considered an optimistic color, people lose their tempers more often in yellow rooms, and babies will cry more. It is the most difficult color for the eye to take in, so it can be overpowering if overused.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 内向者和外向者在恢复心理能量的方式上有着本质区别。外向者往往能从社交互动和协作环境中获得能量，在活跃热闹的场合中如鱼得水。相比之下，内向者通常通过安静的沉思和独处来恢复精力，在独立工作时往往展现出极强的分析能力和高度的专注度。

title: Yellow Tulip
text: How do we imagine the unimaginable? If we're asked to think of an object - say, a yellow tulip – a picture immediately forms in our mind's eye. But what if we try to imagine a concept such as the square root of negative number?

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 我们如何想象那些难以想象的事情？如果我们被要求想象一个物体——比如一朵黄色郁金香——一幅图片就会立即在我们的脑海中形成。但是，如果我们尝试想象一个概念，例如负数的平方根，会怎样呢？

title: Marine Biologist
text: The speaker is a marine biologist who became interested in the Strandlopers, an ancient people who lived on the coastline, because of their connection to the sea. Their way of life intrigued him. As a child he had spent a lot of time by the sea, exploring and collecting things – so he began to study them, and discovered some interesting information about their way of life, how they hunted, what tools they used, and so on.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 演讲者是一位海洋生物学家，他对生活在海岸线上的古人斯特兰德洛普斯人（Strandlopers）感兴趣，因为他们与海洋有联系。他们的生活方式引起了他的兴趣。小时候，他在海边度过了很多时间，探索和收集东西——所以他开始研究它们，发现了一些关于他们的生活方式、他们如何狩猎、他们使用什么工具等等的有趣信息。

title: Company-Oriented Reforms
text: The climate for doing business improved in Egypt more than in any other country last year, according to a global study that revealed a wave of company-oriented reforms across the Middle East. The World Bank rankings, which look at business regulations, also showed that the pace of business reforms in Eastern Europe was overtaking East Asia.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 一项全球研究显示，去年埃及的营商环境改善程度超过任何其他国家，该研究揭示了整个中东地区掀起的一波以公司为导向的改革浪潮。世界银行的排名主要关注商业法规，也显示东欧商业改革的步伐正在超过东亚。

title: Modern Buildings
text: Modern buildings have to achieve certain performance requirements, at least to satisfy those of building codes, to provide a safe, healthy, and comfortable environment. However, these conditioned environments demand resources in energy and materials, which are both limited in supply, to build and operate.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 现代建筑必须达到一定的性能要求，至少满足建筑规范的要求，以提供安全、健康、舒适的环境。然而，这些条件环境的建设和运营需要能源和材料资源，而这些资源的供应都有限。

title: Transportation
text: Not a lot is known about how the transportation of goods by water first began. Large cargo boats were being used in some parts of the world up to five thousand years ago. However, sea trade became more widespread when large sailing boats travelled between ports, carrying spices, perfumes and objects made by hand.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 关于水路货物运输最初是如何开始的，人们知之甚少。早在五千年前，世界上的一些地区就已经开始使用大型货船。然而，当大型帆船在港口之间航行、运送香料、香水和手工制品时，海上贸易变得更加普遍。

title: Studying Abroad
text: Studying abroad is a very popular option for students who come from a wealthy family. Most people believe that overseas experience provides a deeper understanding of cultures and develops communication skills. While this may be true, not all of these new experiences are useful for finding a job. Employers tend to value interpersonal skills and industry knowledge more than cultural background.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 对于来自富裕家庭的学生来说，出国留学是一个非常受欢迎的选择。大多数人认为海外经历可以加深对文化的了解并培养沟通技巧。虽然这可能是真的，但并非所有这些新经历都对找工作有用。雇主往往更看重人际交往能力和行业知识，而不是文化背景。

title: Energy and Pollution
text: Humans need to use energy in order to exist. So it is unsurprising that the way people have been producing energy is largely responsible for current environmental problems. Pollution comes in many forms, but those that are most concerning, because of their impact on health, result from the combustion of fuels in power stations and cars.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 人类需要使用能量才能生存。因此，人们生产能源的方式是造成当前环境问题的主要原因也就不足为奇了。污染有多种形式，但最令人担忧的污染是由发电站和汽车的燃料燃烧造成的，因为它们对健康有影响。

title: Hamburg University
text: Three professors from Hamburg University's medical faculty traveled last month to Ingeborg's sitting room in East Berlin to test her on the work she carried out in pre-war Germany. They were impressed and a special ceremony took place at Hamburg University Medical Centre on Tuesday, in which she finally received the Ph.D. that the Nazis stole from her.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 汉堡大学医学院的三名教授上个月前往东柏林英格堡的客厅，测试她在战前德国所做的工作。他们印象深刻，周二在汉堡大学医学中心举行了特别仪式，她终于获得了博士学位。纳粹从她那里偷走了。

title: Spelling System
text: The problem begins with the alphabet itself. Building a spelling system for English using letters that come from Latin, despite the two languages not sharing exactly the same set of sounds, is like building a playroom using an IKEA office set.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 问题始于字母表本身。尽管两种语言并不共享完全相同的一组声音，但使用来自拉丁语的字母构建英语拼写系统就像使用宜家办公套件构建游戏室一样。

title: US Student Debt
text: The numbers on US student debt, after all, are truly staggering. The average two thousand and fifteen US university graduate who took out loans to help pay for tuition enters the workforce with thirty-five thousand dollars in student debt. In the US, total student debt exceeds one point one five trillion dollars, dwarfing, for instance, the nation's credit card debt.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 毕竟，美国学生债务的数字确实令人震惊。平均每 2015 名通过贷款支付学费的美国大学毕业生在进入劳动力市场时背负着 35000 美元的学生债务。在美国，学生债务总额超过一点五万亿美元，使国家的信用卡债务相形见绌。

title: Population Growth
text: How quickly is the world's population growing? In the United States and other developed countries, the current growth rate is very low. In most developing countries, the human population is growing at a rate of 3 people per second. Because of this bustling growth rate, the human population is well on its way to reaching 9 billion within lifetime.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 世界人口增长速度有多快？在美国等发达国家，目前的增长率非常低。在大多数发展中国家，人口正以每秒 3 人的速度增长。由于这种快速的增长速度，人口有望在有生之年达到 90 亿。

title: William Shakespeare
text: Three hundred and eighty years after his death, William Shakespeare remains the central author of the English-speaking world; he is the most quoted poet and the most regularly produced playwright — and now among the most popular screenwriters as well. teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 威廉·莎士比亚去世三百八十年后，他仍然是英语世界的核心作家。他是被引用最多的诗人和最常创作的剧作家，现在也是最受欢迎的编剧之一。为什么会这样？他“是谁”？为什么很多人都认为他的文笔很棒呢？他的戏剧在他那个时代有什么意义？我们现在如何读、说或听他的话？

title: Your Tutor
text: Your tutor helps you make the most of your time at university by giving you guidance and support along the way. All new students are allocated a personal tutor who will encourage you to get the most out of your course, direct you to other sources of support and help you achieve your goals.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 您的导师会一路为您提供指导和支持，帮助您充分利用大学时光。所有新生都会分配一名个人导师，他会鼓励您充分利用您的课程，指导您获得其他支持来源并帮助您实现目标。

title: Summerhill School
text: Summerhill School was regarded with considerable suspicion by the educational establishment. teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 教育机构对夏山学校抱有相当大的怀疑。学校的课程对于学生来说是可选的，学校的管理由学校理事会执行，所有学生和教职员工都是学校理事会的成员，每个人都有平等的投票权。

title: New Textbook
text: This is a new, accessible and engaging textbook written by academics who also work as consultants with organizations undergoing change. It offers a unique combination of rigorous theoretical exploration together with practical insights from working with those who are actually responsible for managing change.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 这是一本新的、易于理解且引人入胜的教科书，由学者撰写，他们同时也是正在经历变革的组织的顾问。它提供了严格的理论探索与与实际负责管理变革的人员合作的实践见解的独特结合。

title: History is Selective
text: History is selective. What history books tell us about the past is not everything that happened, but what historians have selected. They cannot put in everything: choices have to be made. Choices must similarly be made about which aspects of the past should be formally taught to the next generation in the shape of school history lessons.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速

translation: 历史是有选择性的。历史书告诉我们的过去，并不是发生过的一切，而是历史学家所选择的。他们无法投入一切：必须做出选择。同样，必须选择以学校历史课的形式向下一代正式教授过去的哪些方面。

title: Making Notes
text: The whole purpose of making notes is to aid your learning. It is important to go back over them within a day of making them to make sure they make sense and make them legible for future revisions. Also, going back over them should highlight the key questions of areas in which you want to do further reading.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 做笔记的全部目的是帮助你的学习。重要的是在制作后的一天之内回顾它们，以确保它们有意义并使它们清晰易读，以便将来进行修改。此外，回顾它们应该突出您想要进一步阅读的领域的关键问题。

title: Online Shopping Environments
text: A unique characteristic of online shopping environments is that they allow vendors to create retail interfaces with highly interactive features. One desirable form of interactivity from a consumer perspective is the implementation of sophisticated tools to assist shoppers in their purchase decisions by customizing the electronic shopping environment to their individual preferences.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 在线购物环境的一个独特特征是，它们允许供应商创建具有高度交互功能的零售界面。从消费者的角度来看，一种理想的交互形式是实施复杂的工具，通过根据消费者的个人喜好定制电子购物环境来帮助消费者做出购买决策。

title: Rural Population
text: Thus, a country might possess a sizeable rural population, but have an economic system in which the interests of the voters were predominantly related to their incomes, not to their occupations or location; and in such a country the political system would be unlikely to include an important agrarian party.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 因此，一个国家可能拥有大量农村人口，但其经济体系中选民的利益主要与其收入有关，而不是与其职业或地点有关；在这样一个国家的政治体系中不可能有一个重要的农业政党。

title: Akimbo
text: Akimbo, this must be one of the odder-looking words in the language and puzzles us in part because it doesn't seem to have any relatives. What's more, it is now virtually a fossil word, until recently almost invariably found in arms akimbo, a posture in which a person stands with hands on hips and elbows sharply bent outward, one signalling impatience or hostility.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 阿克夏亚·帕特拉基金会（Akshaya Patra Foundation）是印度的一家非营利组织，致力于消除课堂饥饿。通过每天为数百万学龄儿童提供新鲜烹制、营养均衡的餐食，该倡议鼓励父母定期送孩子上学，从而在城乡社区中同步解决长期营养不良和文盲两大难题。

title: The Concerns of EU Residents
text: In spite of the spectacularly high quality of life for the vast majority of the people who live in the European Union, its inhabitants seem obsessed by the region's relative decline in the world. Slow economic growth rates and high unemployment have reinforced the impression that Europe is unhappy with today and unsure of tomorrow.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 尽管欧盟绝大多数人的生活质量非常高，但其居民似乎对该地区在世界上的相对衰落感到困扰。缓慢的经济增长和高失业率强化了欧洲对今天不满意、对明天不确定的印象。

title: Conservation Scientists
text: Conservation scientists have long tried to map how much of the planet remains undegraded by human activity. Previous estimates using satellite imagery or raw demographic data found anywhere from 20 to 40 percent of the globe was free from obvious human incursions, such as roads, light pollution or the gaping scars of deforestation. But an intact forest canopy can hide an emptied-out ecosystem below.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 长期以来，保护科学家一直试图绘制地球上有多少地区尚未因人类活动而退化的地图。此前使用卫星图像或原始人口数据进行的估计发现，全球 20% 至 40% 的地区没有明显的人类入侵，例如道路、光污染或森林砍伐造成的巨大伤痕。但完整的森林树冠可以隐藏下面空荡荡的生态系统。

title: Demographic Change
text: How quickly this occurs depends on the dynamics of fertility, mortality and overseas migration. While a moderate pace of demographic change allows for gradual adjustment of the economy and policies to the changing population demographics, rapid changes are more difficult to manage. As a result, governments and society as a whole may need to take actions to address these issues.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速

translation: 这种情况发生的速度取决于生育率、死亡率和海外移民的动态。虽然适度的人口变化允许经济和政策逐步调整以适应不断变化的人口结构，但快速的变化更难以管理。因此，政府和整个社会可能需要采取行动来解决这些问题。

title: Babies’ Hearing
text: Most babies start developing their hearing while still in the womb, prompting some hopeful parents to play classical music to their pregnant bellies. Some research even suggests that infants are listening to adult speech as early as 10 weeks before birth, gathering the basic building blocks of their family's native tongue.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 大多数婴儿在子宫内就开始发育听力，这促使一些满怀希望的父母向怀孕的肚子播放古典音乐。一些研究甚至表明，婴儿早在出生前 10 周就开始听成人讲话，积累家庭母语的基本组成部分。

title: Energy Efficiency
text: This finding is understandable in certain cases in spite of its high significance; that is because energy efficiency of building operation just represents a single aspect of sustainability. teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 尽管这一发现具有重要意义，但在某些情况下是可以理解的。这是因为建筑运营的能源效率仅代表可持续性的一个方面。出于同样的原因，建筑材料选择不当的节能建筑可能不被认为是可持续的。

title: Brain Efficiency
text: Efficiency is not your friend when it comes to cognitive growth. In order to keep our brains making new connections and keep them active, you need to keep moving on to another challenging activity as soon as you reach the point of mastery in the one you were engaging in.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 当谈到认知发展时，效率并不是你的朋友。为了让我们的大脑建立新的联系并保持活跃，一旦你掌握了你正在从事的一项活动，你就需要继续进行另一项具有挑战性的活动。

title: Giving Helps with Depression
text: At a time when stress levels are soaring, rates of depression are increasing and the gap between rich and poor is ever widening. We believe that giving can play a positive role in helping people to feel connected to those around them and generate a sense of purpose and hope. When we give, we feel valued, useful and happy.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 在压力水平飙升的时代，抑郁症发病率不断上升，贫富差距不断扩大。我们相信，捐赠可以发挥积极作用，帮助人们感受到与周围人的联系，并产生使命感和希望。当我们给予时，我们会感到被重视、有用和快乐。

title: Publication
text: For the first two or three years after the Second World War, a new title would often sell out within a few months of publication. However, unless public demand for the book was unusually high, they were rarely able to reprint it. With paper stocks strictly rationed, they could not afford to use up precious paper or tie up their limited capital with a reprint.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 在第二次世界大战后的头两三年里，新书常常在出版后几个月内就卖光了。然而，除非公众对这本书的需求异常高，否则他们很少能够重印它。由于纸张库存严格配给，他们无法耗尽珍贵的纸张，也无法用重印来占用有限的资金。

title: The Negative Effects of Immigration
text: There is a tendency, especially in the popular press to concentrate on the negative effects of immigration. In that context, this lecture listing the benefits it brings to more developed nations is much more welcome. Also, it is delivered in a lively and amusing style.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 有一种趋势，特别是在大众媒体中，集中关注移民的负面影响。在这种背景下，本次讲座列出了它给更发达国家带来的好处就更受欢迎了。此外，它以活泼有趣的风格进行表达。

title: The Only Family
text: Imagine living all your life as the only family on your street. Then, one morning, you open the front door and discover houses all around you. You see neighbors tending their gardens and children walking to school. Where did all the people come from? What if the answer turned out to be that they had always been there, you just hadn't seen them?

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 想象一下，你一生都是街上唯一的家人。然后，一天早上，你打开前门，发现周围都是房子。你会看到邻居们在照料花园，孩子们步行去学校。所有的人都是从哪里来的？如果答案是它们一直都在那里，只是你没有看到它们怎么办？

title: Food Is Important
text: Food is one of the most important things you'll ever buy. And yet most people never bother to think about their food and where it comes from. People spend a lot more time worrying about what kind of blue jeans to wear, what kind of video games to play, what kind of computers to buy.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 食物是您购买的最重要的东西之一。然而大多数人却从来不去思考他们的食物以及食物的来源。人们花更多的时间担心穿什么样的蓝色牛仔裤、玩什么样的视频游戏、买什么样的电脑。

title: Charlie Chaplin

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 查理·卓别林和他的兄弟西德尼很小的时候就被安置在孤儿院。 1906年，他成为一名歌舞杂耍演员，加入弗雷德·卡诺的剧团。他的电影处女作是《谋生》，并介绍了著名的肮脏而心软的绅士流浪汉套路，这成为他的标志。为不同工作室制作的众多电影为他带来了世界声誉，所有这些都基于他对悲情和闹剧杂技的掌握。

title: Environmental Policy Course
text: Along with customary classes on subjects such as finance, accounting, and marketing, today's MBA students are enrolling in courses for environmental policy and stewardship. teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 除了金融、会计和营销等常规课程外，如今的 MBA 学生还报读环境政策和管理课程。事实上，根据 2005 年 10 月发布的对 91 所美国商学院的调查，超过一半的商学院要求开设环境可持续性或企业社会责任课程。

title: Attending the Theater
text: Experts discuss the significance of attending the theater as a civic occasion, associated with the political and cultural achievements of Athens. Through archeology and analyses of contemporary art forms such as decoration on pottery, a picture is built up of ancient Greek theater.

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 专家们讨论了参加剧院作为公民活动的重要性，与雅典的政治和文化成就相关。通过考古学和对陶器装饰等当代艺术形式的分析，勾勒出一幅古希腊戏剧的图景。

title: Microscopic Invaders

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 我们都知道细菌、病毒和微生物。我们可以观察这些微小物质如何进入我们的身体并损害我们的器官。我们越来越了解我们的身体如何采取防御策略来击退这些入侵者，并且已经构建了一些巧妙的化学物质来帮助对这些生物恶棍发起攻击。

title: Endangered Languages
text: Despite a number of events in recent years devoted to language diversity, language endangerment, and multilingualism, such as the International Year of Languages, public awareness of the issues is still remarkably limited. teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 尽管近年来举办了许多致力于语言多样性、语言濒危和多语言化的活动，例如国际语言年，但公众对这些问题的认识仍然非常有限。只有四分之一的人知道世界上一半的语言严重濒临灭绝，以至于它们不太可能在本世纪生存。

title: Data-driven

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

title: Consumer Culture
text: In this course, we will explore how such things as department stores, nationally advertised brand-name goods, mass produced cars and suburbs transformed the American economy, society and politics. teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 在本课程中，我们将探讨百货商店、全国宣传的名牌商品、批量生产的汽车和郊区等事物如何改变了美国的经济、社会和政治。该课程按主题和时间顺序组织。每个时期都涉及消费文化史上的新发展。

title: Electric Car
text: First-year university students have designed and built a groundbreaking electric car that recharges itself. teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 一年级大学生设计并制造了一款突破性的自动充电电动汽车。来自悉尼大学工程学院的 50 名学生花了五个月的时间共同使用胶合板、泡沫和玻璃纤维来制造这辆概念车。他们制定了规格并手工制造了汽车。这是一个相当激进的设计：四轮驱动，每个轮子上都有一个电机。

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

title: Primitive Men

teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

title: The Border
text: The border itself between Mexico and the United States is fraught with a mix of urban and desert terrain and spans over one thousand nine hundred miles. teacher_audios.title: Native Speaker 女声 常速
Native Speaker 男声 常速

translation: 墨西哥和美国之间的边界本身充满了城市和沙漠地形，绵延一千九百多英里。边境无人居住区和城市地区是贩毒和非法越境活动最多的地方。德克萨斯州埃尔帕索和加利福尼亚州圣地亚哥等城市的犯罪十分猖獗。

title: Integration

title: CD-Quality Sound
text: Reiss took a stab at settling the argument with a meta-analysis, a study of studies, on whether people can really perceive better-than CD-quality sound. He analyzed data from 18 studies, including more than 400 participants and nearly thirteen thousand listening tests. Overall, listeners picked out the better-than CD-quality track fifty-two point three percent of the time. Statistically significant, if not all that impressive.

title: T-Cells
text: Usually, age is determined by physical characteristics, such as teeth or bones. Great, if you have a body. Researchers have tried unsuccessfully to use blood. The cellular activity that produces these receptors also produces a type of circular DNA molecule as a by-product.

title: IT
text: IT may well change the way you live, yet again. title: Natural Selection
text: Charles Darwin published his paper "On the Origin of Species" in 1859. It is one of the most well-known pieces of scientific literature in human history. In the paper, Darwin proposes the theory of natural selection. He states that for any generation of any species, there will always be a struggle for survival. Individuals who are better suited to the environment are "fitter", and therefore have a much higher chance of surviving and reproducing. This means that later generations are likely to inherit these stronger genetic traits.

translation: 查尔斯·达尔文 (Charles Darwin) 于 1859 年发表了论文《物种起源》。这是人类历史上最著名的科学文献之一。达尔文在论文中提出了自然选择理论。他指出，对于任何物种的任何一代人来说，总会有生存斗争。更适应环境的个体“更适应”，因此有更高的生存和繁殖机会。这意味着后代很可能继承这些更强的遗传特征。
